title: Tiramisu Classic Mascarpone

description: Indulge in the timeless elegance of classic Italian tiramisu, a luxurious dessert that perfectly balances rich espresso, delicate ladyfingers, and a velvety mascarpone cream. This beloved masterpiece offers layers of coffee-infused bliss, making every spoonful a delightful journey to Italy. Prepare to captivate your senses with this authentic and easy-to-follow recipe.

instructions.title: Prepare the Coffee Mixture
instructions.text: Brew strong espresso or coffee and let it cool completely. If desired, stir in the Marsala wine or dark rum. Pour the mixture into a shallow dish, ready for dipping.

instructions.title: Make the Mascarpone Cream Base
instructions.text: In a heatproof bowl, whisk the egg yolks and granulated sugar until pale and creamy. Place the bowl over a saucepan of simmering water (bain-marie), ensuring the bottom of the bowl does not touch the water. Continue whisking constantly for about 8-10 minutes, until the mixture thickens and reaches 160F (71C). Remove from heat and let cool slightly.

instructions.title: Finish the Mascarpone Cream
instructions.text: Gently fold the chilled mascarpone cheese into the cooled egg yolk mixture until smooth and well combined. Be careful not to overmix, which can cause the mascarpone to curdle and lose its creamy texture.

instructions.title: Prepare the Ladyfingers
instructions.text: Quickly dip each ladyfinger into the cooled coffee mixture, one at a time, for just a second or two. It is crucial not to over-soak them, or they will become soggy and fall apart in your tiramisu.

instructions.title: Assemble the First Layer
instructions.text: Arrange a single layer of the coffee-soaked ladyfingers at the bottom of a rectangular serving dish (approximately 8x8 or 9x13 inches). Spread half of the prepared mascarpone cream evenly over the ladyfingers.

instructions.title: Assemble the Second Layer
instructions.text: Repeat the process: add another layer of coffee-soaked ladyfingers over the cream, then cover with the remaining mascarpone cream. Smooth the top with a spatula to create an even surface.

instructions.title: Chill and Serve
instructions.text: Cover the dish tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow the flavors to meld beautifully and the tiramisu to set properly. Before serving, generously dust the top with unsweetened cocoa powder using a fine-mesh sieve.

tips: For the true Italian flavor, use freshly brewed, strong espresso. Avoid instant coffee if possible, or use high-quality instant espresso powder mixed with hot water.
Always use chilled mascarpone cheese. This helps maintain its creamy texture and prevents it from becoming too liquid when folded into the egg mixture.
Tiramisu tastes even better the next day, as the flavors have more time to meld. Store leftovers tightly covered in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days.
